title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 2 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 2 De animae immortalitate ex luce naturae & confessione barbarorum COMPLETE (mid PHYS 339-mid-345 before CAPUT TERTIUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 2 On the immortality of the soul from the light of nature and the confession of barbarians, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 339–mid-345): Cap. 2 title; immortality shown by nature and Scripture (Alsted); Gentile barbarians and philosophers; ancient Getae and Egyptians (Herodotus, Diodorus); recently discovered peoples and antipodes digression (Lactantius, Augustine, Besoldus); Guineans, Chinese, Peruvians (Acosta), Mexicans, Guianans (Raleigh), Tupinamba (Lery), Virginians (Hariot); what barbarian confession shows — Cap. 2 close. Cap. 3 starts mid PHYS 345. Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1 COMPLETE (english files not modified this turn).
